Item.Hint: Enter maximum number of drives to be fetched.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_sponsor_id varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_RETRIEVE','E');
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.DRIVES_SINCE','E');
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.NO_OF_DRIVES','E');
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_DRAW_STATS',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_CLEAR',enabled,property_false);
 v_sponsor_id := :ctrl_blk_1.sponsor_id;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 :ctrl_blk_1.sponsor_id := v_sponsor_id;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :past_drives.drive_id is null then
 go_item( 'past_drives.drive_id' );
 message ('Drive ID must be selected to retrieve drive information.');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 call_window_program('MCWABODR');
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: PAST_DRIVES
Block.WhereClause:
drive_id in 
 (select drive_id from drive_sponsors
 where sponsor_id= :ctrl_blk_1.sponsor_id 
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id) 
and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
and drive_date between 
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.drives_since,
 to_date('01-01-1951','MM-DD-YYYY')) and sysdate
and status ='CNFRM'

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
:ctrl_blk_1.counter := nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.counter,0) + 1;
IF :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_drives is not null THEN
 IF :counter > :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_drives THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 -- Done because if we limit by rownum, It fetches first and sorts later
 END IF;
END IF;
begin
 select location_name 
 into :past_drives.location_name
 from locations 
 where location_id = :past_drives.location_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ;
end ;
begin
 select count(*), nvl(sum(decode(unit_id,null,0,1)),0)
 into :past_drives.actual_show, :past_drives.actual_draw
 from donations
 where drive_id = :past_drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 if :past_drives.actual_show != 0
 and :past_drives.actual_show is not null then
 :past_drives.pcnt_dfrl := nvl( 100*( :past_drives.actual_show - :past_drives.actual_draw )/
 :past_drives.actual_show, 0 );
 end if;
exception
 when others then handle_error ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 v_sponsor_name varchar2(40);
BEGIN
 IF :parameter.sponsor_id is null THEN
 message('Error : No Sponsor ID passed to window');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT substr(name,1,40) INTO v_sponsor_name
 FROM sponsors
 WHERE sponsor_id = :parameter.sponsor_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('11142');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 :system.message_level := '10';
 
 --[Ver: 01 ]
 --[Ver: 02 ] -- IM 8497
 --[Ver: 03 ] -- -- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 set_window_property('window_show', title,' MRWPADRV' || ' [Ver: 01 ]'||
 ' Past Drives ' || ' Sponsor: ' || v_sponsor_name); -- This Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_drives := 3;
 :ctrl_blk_1.drives_since := add_months(trunc(sysdate),-18);
 :ctrl_blk_1.sponsor_id := :parameter.sponsor_id;
 go_block('past_drives');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_drive_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :past_drives.drive_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Retrieve_data IS
BEGIN
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_RETRIEVE','D');
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.DRIVES_SINCE','D');
 Item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.NO_OF_DRIVES','D');
 :system.message_level := '5' ;
 execute_query ;
 :system.message_level := '0' ;
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_CLEAR',enabled,property_true);
 IF :drive_id is null THEN
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_DRAW_STATS',enabled,property_false);
 show_error('11081');
 ELSE
 set_item_property('CTRL_BLK_1.PB_DRAW_STATS',enabled,property_true);
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.NO_OF_DRIVES is null THEN
 last_record;
 :ctrl_blk_1.no_of_drives := :system.cursor_record;
 first_record;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;
